summary: Max Verstappen won the São Paulo Grand Prix from pole position, 8.3s ahead of Lando Norris, with Fernando Alonso completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P15 to P7.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag and 1 safety car.
There were 67 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 4 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 266 points over Sergio Perez.
